notes: One fresh owned private-Xvfb session captured all thirty operations; existing user sessions were untouched.
Raw request and response are retained byte-for-byte, including histories, unit labels, printed uncertainty, source definitions, selection and separate API diagnostics.
Every setup and measurement uses the named command's public EndCommand event. Empty-selection setup commands report failure but retain their accepted display choice.
Independent Fraction witnesses read only source geometry and nominal unit definitions, never observed results or native output.
All thirty native command replays pass at the original fixed absolute tolerance; the largest residual is finite printed precision in cubic yards.
The three earlier scalar discrepancies remain unmodified. This is not a Rhino speed comparison, SubD implementation, or proof of persistence across new Rhino documents or application restarts.
